answer: PoA computes trust by factorizing a normalized EigenTrust feedback matrix, then applies temporal decay with an exponential half-life, so reputation requires sustained honest service. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity can reinforce only established, mutually supported identities; freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality and therefore cannot pass consensus. A canyon of colluders may emit a pulse, but their coordinated fable provides no durable trust.
